items.html: And the reason of the matter is as is known: that Netzah is in the secret of Tifferet, and Hod is in the secret of Malchut, as is said in the book of the Tikunim: "He is in Netzah and she is in Hod." And this is the secret that Netzah and Hod are called the skies [Shahakim], which are two millstones, one above the other, that grind the manna for the righteous, who are Tzadik and Tzedek.
